title: Saiee Manjrekar On Pre-Independence Period Drama: 'It Demands A Different Kind Of Discipline' | Bollywood News - News18
text: Actor Saiee Manjrekar is preparing to step into a completely different cinematic world as she gears up for an upcoming period drama set in pre-Independence India. The project marks a notable shift for the young actor, who says the preparation process has been far more intense and immersive than anything she has experienced before. Saiee Manjrekar On The Challenges Of A Period Film Speaking about the role, Manjrekar revealed that working on a story set in a historical era requires a deeper level of preparation beyond memorising dialogues or performing scenes. “This project has honestly been one of the most challenging and exciting journeys for me so far," she said. “A period drama, especially one set in the pre-Independence era, demands a lot more than just learning lines and showing up on set." According to the actor, the process involves extensive research to understand the social and cultural context of the time. From studying how people lived and spoke to observing their emotional expressions and behavioural patterns, the groundwork has been both demanding and enriching. Research, Diction And Body Language Manjrekar explained that portraying a character from another era requires actors to consciously change their physical and emotional presence on screen. “There is so much homework involved — reading, researching the time, understanding how people lived, spoke, carried themselves, and even how they expressed emotions back then," she said. “Everything is rooted in a certain discipline and grace which is very different from the world we live in today." The actor added that even the smallest details become crucial while preparing for a period role. “What fascinated me the most was how detailed the process is. From body language to posture, from the way you walk into a room to how you react in silence — nothing can feel modern. You have to unlearn many habits and consciously build a new physical and emotional vocabulary." ‘Demanding But Deeply Fulfilling’ Despite the challenges, Manjrekar described the process as creatively rewarding. “It’s demanding, but that’s what makes it so fulfilling. As an actor, I feel incredibly lucky to be part of a film that allows me to explore a completely different time and pushes me to grow," she said. Clearly excited about the project, the actor believes the experience has already taught her valuable lessons about patience, discipline and the craft of performance. As she continues preparing for the role, Manjrekar hopes to bring authenticity and emotional depth to a story rooted in India’s pre-Independence history.
